title: nextflow-template samplesheet schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

platform.errorMessage: platform must be one of: illumina, nanopore, pacbio

fastq_1.errorMessage: FASTQ for read 1 (short read) or the single long-read FASTQ (nanopore/pacbio) must be provided and end with .fastq/.fq(.gz)

fastq_2.errorMessage: FASTQ read 2 — leave empty for single-end short reads and for long reads (nanopore/pacbio)
